backups.edit: Configure backups and delete backup files
claude.use: Use the Claude Code tab (limited by the group's network permissions)
config: Console settings, web access, Claude account and dictation
credentials.edit: Create/edit credentials and lock the vault
dashboard.view: View the Dashboard (server and AI usage)
host.web: Open the host's web UI with automatic login
hosts.edit: Edit hosts, host groups, maps and topology
hosts.view: View hosts, host groups and maps
inbox.decide: Approve/reject requests and archive notices (a request that runs an action on the server = admin only)
inbox.view: View the Notification center (alerts, notices and approval requests)
knowledge.edit: Edit memory, best practices, workflows and agents
knowledge.view: View memory, best practices, workflows, agents, reports and runs
projects.files: Project files (view/edit only inside each project's folder)
projects.create: Create Projects in a new folder of the default base (the creator becomes the owner)
projects.manage: Create/remove Projects and choose the server folder where the agent runs
schedules.edit: Create/edit scheduled tasks (they run as the server account)
schedules.run: Run an existing scheduled task now
scripts.edit: Edit scripts / skills (code that runs as the server account)
server.admin: Local administration (root) of this server — Local host and Files as root
vault.templates: Manage Password vault templates and fields
vault.use: Use Password vault secrets in commands and in the AI without seeing the value (nvault://, vault unlocked)
vault.view: View the Password vault (text fields; secrets masked)
